name: pose_atlas
prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Input image 1 is the user's EVA Gothic anime character reference sheet and is the exact edit target, not inspiration. Extract ONLY the FOURTEEN seated/action full-body character figures from the two bottom rows labelled ANIMATIONEN (DESKTOP-POSE, KOMPAKT). Preserve their EXACT original faces, long curly black-purple twintails, burgundy ribbons, black lace headpiece, crimson eyes, all clothing/accessories, body proportions and original detailed 2D anime drawing style. Do not redraw or redesign any figure. Arrange or preserve them in their original regular grid: SEVEN columns and TWO rows, with exactly one entire pose per cell and clean transparent space between cells. Row 1: seated idle, listening, typing with laptop, reading book, tired/yawning, falling asleep, sleeping. Row 2: rising briefly, stretching, happy, thinking, sitting down with book, alert/ping, waving. Keep all hair and clothing fully visible in each cell and centered horizontally, align bottom edge of each figure within each row. Remove the dark sheet background, divider lines, labels, text, frames, floating comic marks/hearts/zzz and all other sheet content. Export a genuinely transparent PNG with clean alpha edges, especially around curls, lace, fingers and accessories. No new poses, no chibi simplification, no 3D, no cyberpunk, no recoloring, no substitute character, no text. Preserve the original character artwork as closely as possible. Prefer a wide 7:2 atlas composition.

name: expression_atlas
